info.title: Pharmacy Inventory API
info.description: Bearer authentication. Request names are camelCase; financial/master read projections are snake_case. Pagination is zero-based. Purchase/sale errors roll back all lines.

post.description: Returns an 8-hour bearer token. Rate limited.
